result:
Foreman run for 06:28 is finished. Nothing needed restarting or retuning, and I changed nothing.

- **What's running:** 6 FEBio runs on 36 cores, with no two runs sharing a core:
  - four mu03 restart windows (p133, p102, p095, p104), close to their end time (3.7–3.8 of 4.0);
  - cyc3vpen p062 flexion, 8.3 h so far, at t 8.94;
  - ASTM plastic p064 compression, at t 0.51.

  Every log was written within the last 3 s, so nothing is hung or dead.
- **Resources:** CPU is the limit. 28.3 of the 32-core quota is in use, with 5 s of every 10 s throttled. Memory in real use is 17.1 GB of 137 GB; the rest of the cgroup's 137 GB is reclaimable file cache. No new out-of-memory kills (still 2 in total). /raid has 2.2 TB free.
- **Idle:** GPU 1, 3 and 4 are almost unused. More GPU runs would need the same 32 cores, so adding them would not speed anything up.
- **Queues:** both are empty (h19 has 0 waiting and 0 running; the evo task queue has 0). 29 h51 window pairs are waiting for cores, with 4 running.
- **Finished in the last hour:** 4 runs.
  - p148 mu03r flexion, cyc3vpen p124 flexion and p128_gpu2 extension ended normally.
  - p128_gpu2 flexion ended with an error at t 3.61: 3017 negative Jacobians, target not reached. Its fallback restart is already waiting in the h51 queue, so I didn't touch it.
- **Restart resilience:** every live tmux session comes back after a restart through resume_all.sh or the watchdog. The 16 covered sessions that aren't running are finished lanes with DONE markers.

I wrote `work/agents/foreman/report_20261121_0628.md`, overwrote `status.json` and added one line to `foreman_actions.log`. I also wrote the time to `last_run` in ISO format, which differs from the date format it had before.

Still needs a person (same three as last run):
- The scientist needs to decide whether to rerun cyc3vdt p062/p124 flexion, which the watchdog stopped at 23:29 yesterday, or accept it.
- `ops/resume_all.sh`, `ops/astm_lanes.sh` and `ops/push_lanes.sh` are still uncommitted.
- The scientist or PI needs to decide the next step for the 25 failed push_post runs and the ASTM designs that passed fewer than 3 of 3 tests (p064 p076 p082 p088 p120 p121).

The Google Drive connector also needs authorizing in claude.ai's connector settings before it can be used; it isn't needed for this job.
